revisions.title: The fork in participation
revisions.body: Parmenides narrows participation to a fork: if one Form is wholly in many things, it is separated from itself; if each thing receives a part, the Form is divided, and largeness, equality, and smallness become absurdly measured by smaller parts. The section leaves the account needing another way to explain how many things share one Form.
